pl.portal.previewNotice: Preview with synthetic data. Drafts and submissions here are simulated and never reach a buyer.
pl.portal.theme.label: Theme
pl.portal.notFound.title: Page not found
pl.portal.notFound.description: Open the link in the email the buyer sent you. If it does not work, contact the buyer.
pl.portal.home.openFromEmail: To answer a request or send documents, open the link in the email the buyer sent you.
pl.portal.home.scenarios.title: Portal screens preview
pl.portal.home.scenarios.description: Each card is a synthetic supplier link in one situation. Open it to see what a supplier sees, starting from the page an emailed link lands on.
pl.portal.home.scenario.open.title: Open request for quotation
pl.portal.home.scenario.open.description: Three lines to answer, a saved draft, and one line the buyer changed after the last submission.
pl.portal.home.scenario.closed.title: Closed request
pl.portal.home.scenario.closed.descripti: The deadline has passed: the last submission can be read and no longer changed.
pl.portal.home.scenario.sealed.title: Decided request
pl.portal.home.scenario.sealed.descripti: The award is sealed: the outcome of the supplier's own lines, and nothing about anyone else's.
pl.portal.home.scenario.evidence.title: Evidence request
pl.portal.home.scenario.evidence.descrip: Documents the buyer asked for: one requested, one under review, one accepted and one rejected with a reason.
pl.portal.home.scenario.expired.title: Expired link
pl.portal.home.scenario.expired.descript: The link has expired, so it opens nothing and points the supplier to the buyer.
pl.portal.home.scenario.revoked.title: Revoked link
pl.portal.home.scenario.revoked.descript: The buyer withdrew the link, so it opens nothing and points the supplier to the buyer.
pl.portal.home.scenario.slow.title: Slow connection
pl.portal.home.scenario.slow.description: The link opens, but the response form never arrives, so it stays in its loading state.
pl.portal.home.scenario.unavailable.desc: The link opens, but reading the response form fails, so it shows its error state with a retry.
pl.portal.landing.title: Open your secure link
pl.portal.landing.lead: A buyer using Partledger sent you this link to answer a request for quotation or to provide documents they asked for.
pl.portal.landing.nothingRecorded: Loading this page records nothing and tells no one. The link is only checked when you choose Continue.
pl.portal.landing.ownLinesOnly: You will see only your own organisation's lines and outcomes. Other suppliers never see your answers.
pl.portal.landing.keepPrivate: Keep this link to yourself: anyone who has it can answer for your organisation.
pl.portal.landing.exchangeUnavailable: We could not check your link just now. Try again shortly.
pl.portal.linkUnavailable.title: This link is no longer available
pl.portal.linkUnavailable.description: It may have expired, been withdrawn by the buyer, or been copied incompletely.
pl.portal.linkUnavailable.nextStep: Contact the buyer who sent it and ask them for a new link.
pl.portal.session.title: Your request
pl.portal.session.ownLinesOnly: You see only your own organisation's lines and outcomes. Other suppliers never see your answers, and you never see theirs.
pl.portal.line.label: Line {line}
pl.portal.line.changed: This line changed — review and resubmit
pl.portal.line.changedDetail: The buyer changed it in version {version} on {changedAt}. Your earlier answer is kept below; check it against the change and submit again.
pl.portal.noQuoteReason.capacity: No capacity before the date needed
pl.portal.respond.title: Your response
pl.portal.respond.subtitle: {reference} · {title}
pl.portal.respond.intro: {buyer} asked your organisation to answer {count} lines. For each one, give a quote, decline with a reason, or offer an alternate part.
pl.portal.respond.deadlineRule: Times are shown in your time zone ({timeZone}) with UTC beside them. The buyer's server decides by its own clock in UTC, and refuses a submission that arrives after the deadline.
pl.portal.respond.field.oneOffCostsHint: Tooling, setup or first-article costs charged once. Enter 0 if there are none.
pl.portal.respond.field.specificationHin: Give its part number and how it differs from the part requested.
pl.portal.respond.declaration.title: Submit your response
pl.portal.respond.declaration.descriptio: The buyer receives every line at once. You can revise and submit again until the deadline.
pl.portal.respond.declaration.name: Your full name
pl.portal.respond.declaration.nameHint: Recorded with the submission as the person who submitted it.
pl.portal.respond.declaration.attestatio: I am authorised to submit this response on behalf of {supplier}.
pl.portal.respond.submittedPreview: Your response was checked and submitted in this preview. Nothing was sent to the buyer.
pl.portal.respond.error.answerRequired: Choose a quote, a no-quote or an alternate part for this line.
pl.portal.respond.error.currency: Choose the currency of your prices.
pl.portal.respond.error.unitPrice: Enter a unit price greater than 0, such as 52.40.
pl.portal.respond.error.minimumOrderQuan: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
pl.portal.respond.error.leadTimeDays: Enter the lead time as a whole number of days.
pl.portal.respond.error.oneOffCosts: Enter the one-off costs, or 0 if there are none.
pl.portal.respond.error.validUntil: Enter the last day your prices are valid.
pl.portal.respond.error.specification: Describe the alternate part you offer.
pl.portal.respond.error.noQuoteReason: Choose why you are not quoting this line.
pl.portal.respond.error.attestation: Confirm that you may submit for your organisation.
pl.portal.submission.title: Your last submission
pl.portal.submission.readOnlyOpen: This is what the buyer will receive from you. To change it, edit your response and submit again before the deadline.
pl.portal.submission.readOnlyClosed: The request has closed, so this submission can no longer be changed.
pl.portal.submission.none.title: No response submitted
pl.portal.submission.none.descriptionOpe: You have not submitted a response yet. Submit it from your response before the deadline.
pl.portal.submission.none.descriptionClo: The request closed before your organisation submitted a response.
pl.portal.outcome.title: Outcome
pl.portal.outcome.summary: The buyer decided this request on {sealedAt}. {awarded} of your {total} lines were awarded to your organisation.
pl.portal.outcome.ownLinesOnly: This shows the outcome of your own lines only. Who won the other lines and at what price is not shared with you, and your prices are not shared with other suppliers.
pl.portal.outcome.nextStep: For an awarded line, the buyer will contact you about the purchase order.
pl.portal.evidence.title: Evidence requests
pl.portal.evidence.intro: {buyer} asked your organisation for these documents. Each one is reviewed by the buyer's quality team.
pl.portal.evidence.empty.title: Nothing requested
pl.portal.evidence.empty.description: The buyer has no open requests for documents from your organisation.
pl.portal.evidence.next.requested: Upload the document by the date needed.
pl.portal.evidence.next.underReview: Nothing to do: the buyer is reviewing your document.
pl.portal.evidence.next.accepted: Nothing to do: the buyer accepted your document.
pl.portal.evidence.next.rejected: Upload a corrected document by the date needed.
pl.portal.evidence.uploadUnavailable: Uploading documents is not available yet.
